title: Purple Energy Warrior Poses
description: Four sequential views of a dark-skinned female warrior with short white hair, wearing a purple and white armored outfit with leaf-like patterns. She is shown in dynamic combat stances, channeling and projecting bright purple magical energy from her hands in the form of swirling orbs, beams, and explosive bursts.
prompt: A dark-skinned female warrior with short silver-white hair in four different dynamic combat poses against a black background. She wears a revealing purple and white fantasy armor with leaf-shaped flaps and gold accents. In each pose she manipulates intense purple magical energy, creating glowing orbs, energy beams, and explosive particle effects from her hands. Cinematic lighting, dramatic purple highlights, detailed skin texture and fabric, fantasy character art style.
